component.name: Patrone Terminal
component.summary: A terminal with tabs, copy on select and paste on right-click

description.p: Patrone Terminal is PatroneOS's terminal, built on GTK 4 and VTE. Selecting text copies it, a right-click pastes, and Ctrl+click opens links. Escape clears the command line at the shell's prompt.

ul.li: PatroneOS Mono, or a font of your choice, and a see-through background
Asks before closing a tab where a program is still running

description.p: As a Flatpak it runs the computer's own shell and programs, so it works like any terminal there.
Patrone Terminal as a Flatpak, for any Linux, running the computer's own shell.
